title: aidd findings
description: The format of schemas/findings.json: the codes aidd gives when a check finds something, each with its meaning and its next step, in one place. A group holds the codes of one owner, and a code is written once, here. Code that gives a code, and a schema that lists it, read this file and never restate it.

groups.description: One group for each owner, by name. A full code is `<group>.<code>`.

owner.description: The package under `src/aidd` that gives these codes.

description.description: What the codes of this group say, and in what order they stand.

codes.description: Each code of the group, by its bare name.

title.description: The code in a few words, with no period.

why.description: What the code means: the condition that gives it.

next.description: What to do about it. `what` is one sentence.

reserved.description: The `delegate` group's: whether the person decides, whatever the delegation says.
